items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: "Hank Jones -- the band -- we put these things together like head arrangements." and "especially with Hank. Hank would run the thing down..."

ctx.x: Hank Jones -- the band -- we put these things together like head arrangements. All what we did was that --
The tunes belonged to me, you know. When Dave had did about four things or eight -- four or five things on the coast -- he decided that since -- that he wanted to finish the album.
